common.active_help: Off: the account stays stored, but the mail server refuses its mail and it cannot log in.
common.password_help: The panel stores only the hash of the password. The password rules of the domain and of the panel must accept it.
common.keep_mailbox_days_help: How long the mail files of a deleted mailbox stay on disk. The cleanup script removes them after that. Forever keeps them until somebody deletes them by hand.
common.domain_help: The mail domain that the address belongs to. The list holds the domains that you manage.

wblist.rdns_intro: Manage reverse DNS based white/blacklist for iRedAPD.
wblist.senderscore_intro: Permanently whitelist IP addresses to bypass SenderScore checks.
wblist.title: White/Blacklist
wblist.msg_rdns_in_both: :name is in both the whitelist and the blacklist.
wblist.remove_all_confirm: Remove every entry that this list shows?
wblist.msg_invalid_kind: The type must be W or B.
wblist.rdns_whitelist_legend_help: One domain per line. Mail from a server whose reverse DNS matches skips greylisting.
wblist.rdns_blacklist_legend_help: One domain per line. Mail from a server whose reverse DNS matches is refused.
wblist.senderscore_legend_help: One IP address per line, IPv4 or IPv6. These addresses always skip the SenderScore check.
wblist.inbound_title_help: A rule here applies to the mail that arrives for this address. A whitelisted sender always gets through, a blacklisted sender is refused.
wblist.outbound_title_help: A rule here applies to the mail that this address sends. A whitelisted recipient always gets the mail, a blacklisted recipient does not.

spampolicy.title: Spam Policy
spampolicy.tag_level_help: Amavisd adds the X-Spam headers to mail that scores above this value. Delivery does not change. A lower value marks more mail. Default: 2.0
spampolicy.tag2_level_help: Mail that scores above this value counts as spam and gets the subject tag. A lower value tags more mail, a higher value less. Default: 6.2
spampolicy.kill_level_help: Mail that scores above this value is blocked or quarantined instead of delivered. A lower value blocks more mail and can lose wanted messages. Default: 6.9
spampolicy.subject_tag_help: Text put in front of the subject of mail above the first threshold. Leave it empty to keep the subject unchanged.
spampolicy.subject_tag2_help: Text put in front of the subject of spam, for example [SPAM]. Leave it empty to keep the subject unchanged.
spampolicy.always_insert_x_spam_headers_help: Writes the X-Spam headers into every message, also into clean mail, so a mail client can filter on the score. The panel stores this as a tag level of -999.
spampolicy.quarantine_spam_help: Where spam goes: the server default, the quarantine, or straight to the mailbox. Quarantine keeps the message until an admin releases it.
spampolicy.quarantine_virus_help: The same choice for mail that carries a virus. Without quarantine the message is not kept, so nobody can release it.
spampolicy.quarantine_banned_help: The same choice for mail that carries a banned attachment type.
spampolicy.quarantine_bad_header_help: The same choice for mail whose headers break the mail standard.
spampolicy.bypass_virus_help: Skips the virus scan for this account. Mail arrives faster and unchecked. Use it only for an address you trust.
spampolicy.bypass_spam_help: Skips the spam scan for this account. No message is tagged or blocked as spam.
spampolicy.bypass_banned_help: Skips the attachment check, so a banned file type also arrives.
spampolicy.bypass_header_help: Skips the header check, so mail with broken headers also arrives.
spampolicy.deliver_virus_help: Delivers mail that carries a virus to the mailbox instead of blocking it. The scan still runs and writes its result into the headers.
spampolicy.deliver_spam_help: Delivers spam to the mailbox instead of blocking it, also above the block threshold.
spampolicy.deliver_banned_help: Delivers mail with a banned attachment instead of blocking it.
spampolicy.deliver_bad_header_help: Delivers mail with broken headers instead of blocking it.

compat.source_remote: Source: the compatibility list on GitHub, checked :time.
compat.source_offline: GitHub could not be read. The list bundled with this iRedPanel version is shown.
compat.source_local: The update check is disabled. The list bundled with this iRedPanel version is shown.
compat.unavailable: The compatibility list could not be read. See the server log.
compat.intro: The iRedMail versions that each iRedPanel release is compatible with.

fail2ban.title: Fail2ban
fail2ban.no_banned: No banned IPs in this jail.

throttle.none_configured: No throttle settings configured for this account.
throttle.kind_help: Which traffic the limit counts: outbound is mail the account sends, inbound is mail it receives, external counts a sender outside the served domains.
throttle.period_seconds_help: The length of the counting window. The counters start again after this many seconds: 3600 counts per hour, 86400 per day.
throttle.max_messages_help: How many messages the account may send in one period. -1 takes the domain or global setting, 0 means unlimited.
throttle.max_quota_bytes_help: How many bytes in total the account may send in one period. -1 takes the domain or global setting, 0 means unlimited.
throttle.max_message_size_help: The largest single message in bytes. A bigger message is refused. -1 takes the domain or global setting, 0 means unlimited.

user.msg_quota_exceeds_max: User quota (:quota MB) exceeds domain maximum (:max MB)
user.msg_total_quota_exceeded: Total domain quota would be exceeded
user.msg_total_quota_exceeded_detail: Total domain quota would be exceeded (:used + :quota > :max MB)
user.msg_alias_domain_mismatch: The alias address must be in the domain :domain
user.msg_admin_quota_limit: The quota limit of your admin account is reached: :used of :max MB is assigned.
user.msg_admin_quota_unlimited: Your admin account has a quota limit, so the mailbox needs a quota other than unlimited (0).
user.keep_copy: Keep a local copy of forwarded messages
user.aliases_desc: Additional email addresses that deliver to this mailbox.
user.no_aliases: No alias addresses configured for this user.
user.bcc_desc: BCC copies of sent or received emails to the specified addresses.
user.relay_desc: Route outbound mail from this user through a specific relay server.
user.msg_invalid_quota: The quota must be a whole number of 0 or more (MB).
user.msg_password_or_hash: Enter either a password or a password hash.
user.msg_invalid_password_hash: The password hash must start with a supported scheme, such as {SSHA512} or {CRYPT}.
user.msg_invalid_mailbox_format: Choose maildir, mdbox or sdbox as the mailbox format.
user.msg_invalid_mailbox_folder: The mailbox folder must be 1 to 20 letters or digits.
user.msg_maildir_global_only: Only a global admin can set the maildir path.
user.msg_invalid_maildir: The maildir path must be an absolute path of at least four directories: lowercase letters, digits and . _ @ + -.
user.msg_maildir_in_use: The maildir path belongs to another mailbox.
user.msg_invalid_transport: The transport may contain only letters, digits and . _ / : [ ] @ + -.
user.password_hash_help: Instead of a password: a hash with its scheme, such as {SSHA512}... The password policy does not check a hash.
user.maildir_path_help: Absolute path of the mailbox. Empty uses the default path. The path must not belong to another mailbox.
user.transport_help: Postfix transport of this mailbox, for example dovecot. Empty uses the transport of the domain.
user.identifier_help: The part before the @ of the address. Later it changes only with the rename button on the user page.
user.full_name_help: The name that the panel and the webmail show for this mailbox.
user.language_help: The language of the panel and of the self-service pages for this user. Default language uses the panel setting.
user.password_repeat_help: Type the same password again. The panel refuses the save when the two differ.
user.quota_mb_label_help: The disk space of the mailbox in MB. 0 means unlimited, and the limits of the domain bound the value.
user.mailbox_format_help: How Dovecot stores the mail: maildir keeps one file per message, mdbox and sdbox keep several messages in one file. It is set at creation, and the mail server must support the format.
user.mailbox_folder_help: The name of the mail directory inside the mailbox path, normally Maildir. Letters and digits only, at most 20 characters.
user.record_active_help: Off: the mailbox keeps its mail, but it cannot log in and the mail server refuses its mail.
user.first_name_help: The given name of the user. The panel and the address book show it.
user.last_name_help: The family name of the user. The panel and the address book show it.
user.employee_number_help: A free number of your own, for example a staff number. The panel only stores it.
user.position_help: The job title of the user. The panel and the address book show it.
user.mobile_phone_help: The mobile number of the user. The panel only stores it.
user.work_phone_help: The work number of the user. The panel only stores it.
user.current_password_help: The panel asks for it because the setting "Require old password on change" is on. It must match the stored password.
user.service_enableSmtp_help: Off: the mailbox cannot send mail. Receiving is not affected.
user.service_enableSmtpSecured_help: The same permission over an encrypted connection, the usual way a mail client sends. Turn both off to stop sending completely.
user.service_enablePop3_help: Off: the mailbox cannot be read with POP3.
user.service_enablePop3Secured_help: POP3 over an encrypted connection, the usual way a mail client reads with POP3.
user.service_enableImap_help: Off: the mailbox cannot be read with IMAP. A webmail that reads over IMAP stops working too.
user.service_enableImapSecured_help: IMAP over an encrypted connection, the usual way a mail client reads with IMAP.
user.service_enableManagesieve_help: The user manages the server-side mail filters (vacation reply, rules) with it. Off: the stored filters keep running, but the user cannot change them.
user.service_enableSogo_help: Off: the user cannot log in to the webmail. The mailbox itself keeps working.
user.forwarding_addresses_help: The mail of this mailbox also goes to these addresses, one per line.
user.keep_copy_help: On: a copy of a forwarded message stays in the mailbox. Off: the message only leaves and the mailbox stays empty.
user.relay_host_help: The outbound mail of this mailbox goes to this server instead of a direct delivery. Empty: the setting of the domain applies.
user.new_password_help: The new password replaces the stored one at once. The admin signs in with it on the next login.
user.department_help: The department of the user. The panel only stores it.
user.birthday_help: The birthday of the user, as YYYY-MM-DD. Empty means not set. The panel only stores it.
user.msg_invalid_birthday: Invalid birthday. Use the YYYY-MM-DD format.
user.allow_nets_help: IP addresses and CIDR ranges the mailbox may log in from, separated by a comma. Empty allows every address. Dovecot checks this on every IMAP, POP3 and SMTP login, so a wrong entry locks the user out.
user.msg_invalid_allow_nets: Invalid login IP restriction. Use IP addresses and CIDR ranges separated by a comma.
user.password_last_change_help: The date of the last password change. The panel writes it on every password change (SQL `mailbox.passwordlastchange`, LDAP `shadowLastChange`). None means that the backend holds no date yet.
user.msg_quota_below_used: The mailbox already stores :used MB. A domain admin cannot set the quota to :quota MB; ask a global admin.

mlist.msg_invalid_max_msg_size: The max message size must be a whole number of 0 or more.
mlist.options_hint: mlmmj keeps these options in the list spool, not in the account.
mlist.opt_close_list: Close the list to subscription by mail
mlist.opt_disable_subscription_confirm: Add a subscriber without a confirmation mail
mlist.opt_disable_digest_text: Digest mail without a thread summary
mlist.opt_disable_retrieving_subscribers: Disable retrieving the subscriber list by mail
mlist.opt_disable_send_copy_to_sender: Do not send a copy to the sender
mlist.opt_notify_owner_when_sub_unsub: Notify the owners on subscription and unsubscription
mlist.opt_notify_sender_when_moderated: Notify the sender when the message is moderated
mlist.newsletter_help: Anyone can subscribe or unsubscribe on a public page. Every request is confirmed by email.
mlist.owners_hint_help: Owners can manage list settings and moderate messages.
mlist.moderators_hint_help: When the access policy is "Moderators Only", only moderators can post to the list. An empty list sets the postmaster of the domain.
mlist.max_msg_size_help: A message larger than this size in bytes is refused. 0 means no limit.
mlist.keep_archive_help: On: the mlmmj archive of the list stays on disk after the delete. Off: mlmmj removes the archive with the list.
mlist.subscribers_hint_help: Write one address per line. mlmmj holds the subscribers, not the account.
mlist.subscription_help: normal: every message. digest: one collected mail. nomail: no mail, but the subscriber may still post.
mlist.require_confirm_help: On: mlmmj sends a confirmation mail and adds the subscriber after the answer. Off: the panel adds the subscriber at once.
mlist.opt_subject_prefix_help: mlmmj writes this text at the front of the subject of every message, for example [list]. Empty leaves the subject as it is.
mlist.opt_footer_text_help: mlmmj appends this text to the end of every plain text message.
mlist.opt_footer_html_help: mlmmj appends this HTML to the end of every HTML message.
mlist.opt_custom_headers_help: mlmmj adds these headers to every message, one header per line, for example Reply-To: list@example.com.
mlist.opt_remove_headers_help: mlmmj removes these headers from a message before it sends it. One header name per line.
mlist.opt_extra_addresses_help: mlmmj sends every message of the list to these addresses too. They are not subscribers, so the list policy does not let them post.
mlist.opt_subscription_moderators_help: These addresses approve a subscription request when subscription moderation is on. Empty uses the owners.
mlist.opt_close_list_help: On: nobody subscribes by mail. The admin still adds a subscriber on this page.
mlist.opt_disable_subscription_help: On: mlmmj refuses every subscription request, from mail and from the confirmation page.
mlist.opt_disable_subscription_confirm_help: On: mlmmj adds the subscriber at once. Off: it waits for the answer to a confirmation mail.
mlist.opt_moderated_help: On: every message waits for the approval of a moderator before the list sends it.
mlist.opt_moderate_non_subscriber_post_help: On: a message from an address that is not a subscriber waits for the approval of a moderator.
mlist.opt_moderate_subscription_help: On: a subscription request waits for the approval of a moderator or of a subscription moderator.
mlist.opt_disable_archive_help: On: mlmmj keeps no copy of the messages. The retrieval of an old message then has nothing to answer.
mlist.opt_disable_digest_subscription_help: On: nobody subscribes in digest mode, so the collected mail stays off.
mlist.opt_disable_digest_text_help: On: the digest mail carries only the messages, without the list of the subjects at the top.
mlist.opt_disable_nomail_subscription_help: On: nobody subscribes in nomail mode, so every subscriber gets the mail.
mlist.opt_disable_retrieving_old_posts_help: On: nobody asks the list for an old message by mail.
mlist.opt_only_subscriber_can_get_old_posts_he: On: only a subscriber asks for an old message. Off: anybody asks.
mlist.opt_disable_retrieving_subscribers_help: On: a mail request for the subscriber list is refused. The list then stays visible on this page only.
mlist.opt_disable_send_copy_to_sender_help: On: the sender gets no copy of its own message.
mlist.opt_notify_owner_when_sub_unsub_help: On: mlmmj mails the owners at every subscription and unsubscription.
mlist.opt_notify_sender_when_moderated_help: On: the sender gets a mail that says the message waits for a moderator.

sysset.title: System Settings
sysset.intro: These settings are configured via environment variables and cannot be changed from this panel.
sysset.backend_help: The store that holds the domains and the mailboxes: ldap, mysql or pgsql. It is chosen at installation and cannot be changed from the panel.

panelset.title: Panel Settings
panelset.footer_note: Settings stored in the database override .env values. To revert a setting, delete its row from the panel_settings table.
panelset.msg_invalid: These values are invalid and were not saved: :fields
panelset.msg_ip_lockout: The allowed IP ranges were not saved, because they do not include your own address :ip.
panelset.label_brandName_help: The name in the browser tab, next to the logo and in the footer. The panel also sends its mail under this name.
panelset.label_brandLogoUrl_help: The image next to the panel name. Write an http(s) URL or a path inside the panel, for example /static/logo.png.
panelset.label_brandFooterText_help: A free text line at the bottom of every page, before the version link. Empty hides it.
panelset.label_brandPrimaryColor_help: The accent color of the buttons, the links and the active menu item. Write a CSS color such as #3b82f6. An invalid value is ignored.
panelset.label_passwordMinLength_help: The shortest password the panel accepts. It applies to a new password only; the stored ones stay as they are.
panelset.label_passwordIncludesSpecialChars_help: On: a new password must carry at least one character that is not a letter or a digit.
panelset.label_passwordIncludesNumbers_help: On: a new password must carry at least one digit.
panelset.label_passwordIncludesLowercase_help: On: a new password must carry at least one lowercase letter.
panelset.label_passwordIncludesUppercase_help: On: a new password must carry at least one uppercase letter.
panelset.label_passwordHashesUsePrefixedScheme_he: On: a PLAIN or PLAIN-MD5 hash is written with its {SCHEME} prefix. The other schemes always carry a prefix.
panelset.label_passwordDefaultScheme_help: The scheme that hashes a new password. SSHA512 and BCRYPT are the safe choices. CRAM-MD5 and NTLM need doveadm on the server.
panelset.label_requireOldPasswordOnChange_help: On: the current password must be typed to change a mailbox password. The panel refuses the change when it does not match.
panelset.label_sessionTimeout_help: How long a session stays open with no request. A lower value logs an idle admin out sooner. The smallest accepted value is 60.
panelset.label_sessionValidateIp_help: On: a session ends when the client IP address changes. It stops a stolen session cookie and logs out an admin whose network changes.
panelset.label_allowedIpRanges_help: Only these addresses may open the panel. Write CIDR ranges separated by commas, for example 10.0.0.0/8, 192.168.1.5/32. Empty allows every address, and a value that excludes your own address is refused.
panelset.label_defaultLanguage_help: The language for a visitor who has not chosen one. An admin's own choice wins over it.
panelset.label_paginationPerPage_help: How many rows one list page shows. A higher value means fewer pages and a slower query.
panelset.label_checkUpdates_help: On: the panel downloads the compatibility list from GitHub and keeps it for 24 hours. Off: it reads the list shipped with the panel. Turn it off on a server with no outbound internet access.
panelset.label_requireDomainOwnershipVerification: On: a domain can be created only after its ownership is proven with a DNS record. The create form shows the code to publish.
panelset.label_amavisdEnabled_help: On: the quarantine, mail log, spam policy and white/blacklist pages appear. The amavisd database connection must be configured.
panelset.label_amavisdRemoveQuarantinedInDays_hel: The cleanup button on the quarantine page deletes the quarantined messages older than this many days. The cron script uses the same value.
panelset.label_amavisdRemoveMaillogInDays_help: The cleanup button on the quarantine page deletes the mail log rows older than this many days. The cron script uses the same value.
panelset.label_fail2banEnabled_help: On: the Fail2ban page appears with the jails and the banned addresses. The panel reads them through the Fail2ban socket.
panelset.label_fail2banSocket_help: The path of the Fail2ban control socket, normally /var/run/fail2ban/fail2ban.sock. The web server user must be able to read it.
panelset.label_fail2banJails_help: The jails that the Fail2ban page shows, separated by commas, for example postfix, dovecot. Empty shows no jail.
panelset.label_iredapdEnabled_help: On: the throttle, greylisting, rDNS and SenderScore pages appear. The iredapd database connection must be configured.
panelset.label_geoIpDbPath_help: The path of a GeoLite2 .mmdb file. With it the Fail2ban page shows the country of a banned address. Empty turns the lookup off.
panelset.label_apiEnabled_help: On: the endpoints under /api/v1 answer a request that carries a valid key. Off: every API request gets 403.
panelset.label_apiKey_help: One key from the configuration, kept for an older integration. A request that carries it has full access, so leave it empty when nothing needs it.
panelset.label_apiAllowedIps_help: Only these addresses may call the API. Write addresses or CIDR ranges separated by commas. Empty allows every address.
panelset.secret_stored: A value is stored; type a new one to replace it
panelset.label_activityLoggingEnabled_help: On: every administrator action is written to the activity log in the iredadmin database. Off: nothing is recorded. Default: on.
panelset.label_amavisdQuarantineHost_help: Host of the Amavisd AM.PDP service that releases a quarantined message. Empty uses the Amavisd database host. Default: empty.
panelset.label_amavisdQuarantinePort_help: TCP port of the Amavisd AM.PDP service. Default: 9998.
panelset.label_publicUrl_help: The address the panel puts in the links it sends by mail, for example https://panel.example.com. Empty leaves those links broken. Default: empty.
panelset.label_newsletterExpireHours_help: How many hours a newsletter confirmation link stays valid. Default: 24.
panelset.label_smtpHost_help: The mail server the panel sends newsletter confirmations and quarantine notices through. Empty stops every outgoing mail. Default: empty.
panelset.label_smtpPort_help: Port of the SMTP server. Default: 465 with tls, 587 otherwise.
panelset.label_smtpSecurity_help: none sends without encryption, starttls upgrades a plain connection, tls connects encrypted. Default: starttls.
panelset.label_smtpTlsVerify_help: On: the panel refuses a server whose certificate does not validate. Off: it accepts any certificate. Default: on.
panelset.label_smtpUser_help: The account the panel authenticates with. Empty sends without authentication. Default: empty.
panelset.label_smtpFrom_help: The From address of the mail the panel sends. Empty uses the SMTP user. Default: empty.
panelset.label_smtpPassword_help: The password of the SMTP user. It is stored encrypted with IREDPANEL_SECRET_KEY and never shown again. Empty sends without authentication.
panelset.label_mlmmjadminApiUrl_help: Address of the mlmmjadmin API that owns the mlmmj list spool, for example http://127.0.0.1:7790/api. Empty stops every mailing list operation.
panelset.label_mlmmjadminApiToken_help: One of the api_auth_tokens in /opt/mlmmjadmin/settings.py on the mail server. It is stored encrypted with IREDPANEL_SECRET_KEY and never shown again.

domain.msg_ownership_required: Domain ownership must be verified before creation. Add a DNS TXT record with the value :code to :domain, then verify it on the Domain Ownership page.
domain.bulk_delete_confirm: Delete selected domains and all their users?
domain.catchall_desc: A catch-all address receives all emails sent to non-existent addresses under this domain.
domain.bcc_desc: BCC copies of all sent or received emails to the specified addresses.
domain.sender_bcc_placeholder: Leave empty to disable sender BCC
domain.recipient_bcc_placeholder: Leave empty to disable recipient BCC
domain.relay_desc: Route outbound mail from this domain through a specific relay server.
domain.relay_format: Format: [hostname]:port — square brackets prevent MX lookup.
domain.msg_is_alias_domain: The domain :domain is already an alias domain
domain.msg_password_length_range: The min password length (:min) exceeds the max password length (:max). No password can meet both limits.
domain.disabled_services_help: A new mailbox in this domain starts with these services disabled. Existing mailboxes do not change.
domain.backup_mx_enable: This server is a backup MX for the domain
domain.backup_mx_help: The server accepts the mail and relays it to the primary MX. When the field is empty, Postfix uses the MX records of the domain.
domain.self_service_enable: Users of this domain can log in to manage their own preferences
domain.disabled_domain_profiles: Domain pages closed for domain admins
domain.disabled_domain_profiles_help: Domain admins cannot open the checked pages of this domain.
domain.disabled_user_profiles: User pages closed for domain admins
domain.disabled_user_profiles_help: Domain admins cannot open the checked pages of the users in this domain.
domain.msg_min_password_below_global: The min password length must not be lower than the global minimum (:min).
domain.admins_desc: The admins of this domain manage its users, aliases and mailing lists. Add an existing admin or a mailbox; a mailbox becomes a domain admin and logs in with its own password.
domain.admins_desc_domain_admin: Add a mailbox of this domain; it becomes a domain admin and logs in with its own password.
domain.remove_admin_confirm: Remove :address from the admins of this domain?
domain.msg_admin_added: Added :address to the admins of the domain
domain.msg_admin_removed: Removed :address from the admins of the domain
domain.msg_admin_unknown: No admin or mailbox exists with the address :address
domain.msg_admin_not_allowed: A domain admin can add or remove only the mailboxes of its own domains: :address
domain.msg_admin_self: You cannot remove yourself from the admins of the domain
domain.domain_name_help: The part after the @ of every address of this domain, for example example.com. It cannot be changed later; a wrong name has to be deleted and created again.
domain.max_quota_help: The largest quota one mailbox of this domain may have, in MB. A create or a quota change above it is refused. 0 means unlimited.
domain.domain_quota_help: The sum of the mailbox quotas of the domain, in MB. A new mailbox is refused when the sum would pass it. 0 means unlimited.
domain.max_mailboxes_help: How many mailboxes the domain may hold. A create above it is refused. 0 means unlimited.
domain.max_aliases_help: How many mail aliases the domain may hold. 0 means unlimited.
domain.max_lists_help: How many mailing lists the domain may hold. 0 means unlimited.
domain.transport_help: How Postfix delivers the mail of this domain. dovecot is the local delivery. Change it only when the other transport is configured in Postfix.
domain.backup_mx_enable_help: On: this server accepts the mail of the domain and relays it to the primary MX. The domain keeps no mailbox here.
domain.primary_mx_help: The server that receives the relayed mail, for example [mx1.example.com]:25. The square brackets stop the MX lookup. Empty: Postfix uses the MX records of the domain.
domain.default_user_quota_help: The quota that the create form of a new mailbox proposes, in MB. 0 uses the global default. It does not change an existing mailbox.
domain.min_password_length_help: The shortest password for the mailboxes of this domain. 0 uses the panel setting, and a value below the panel minimum is refused.
domain.max_password_length_help: The longest password for the mailboxes of this domain. 0 means unlimited.
domain.self_service_help: A mailbox user of this domain logs in on the same login page and manages its own settings. The user cannot change the checked preferences.
domain.self_service_enable_help: Off: only an admin can log in; a mailbox user of this domain cannot.
domain.disclaimer_text_help: The text that the mail server appends to the outgoing mail of this domain. The panel stores it, and the disclaimer script of the mail server writes the files.
domain.forward_to_help: The address that receives every mail sent to an address that does not exist in this domain. Empty and saved: the catch-all is removed and such mail is refused.
domain.sender_bcc_help: Every mail that this domain sends also goes to this address. The sender does not see the copy.
domain.recipient_bcc_help: Every mail that this domain receives also goes to this address. The sender does not see the copy.
domain.relay_host_help: The outbound mail of this domain goes to this server instead of a direct delivery. Empty: Postfix delivers it itself.

admin.msg_email_required: A valid email address is required
admin.msg_cannot_remove_last_global: Cannot remove global admin role or disable the last global admin
admin.resource_limits_hint: Set resource creation limits for this admin. Use -1 for unlimited.
admin.limits_not_global: The limits do not apply to a global admin.
admin.disable_viewing_mail_log: Do not allow viewing the mail log
admin.disable_managing_quarantined_mails: Do not allow managing quarantined mails
admin.msg_hosted_domain: A standalone admin cannot use the hosted domain :domain. Make a mailbox of this domain an admin instead.
admin.msg_cannot_remove_self: You cannot delete or disable your own admin account
admin.msg_invalid_limit: :field: enter -1 for unlimited or a whole number of 0 or more.
admin.global_administrator_help: On: this mailbox manages every domain and every setting of the panel. Off: it manages only the domains where it is an admin.
admin.email_address_help: The login address of the admin. It is also a mail address when the account is a mailbox.
admin.display_name_help: The name that the panel shows for this admin in the lists.
admin.repeat_password_help: Type the same password again. If the two differ, the panel refuses the save.
admin.assign_domain_help: The admin manages the domain that you pick here, and every mailbox, alias and list of that domain.
admin.max_domains_help: How many domains this admin creates. -1 means unlimited, 0 refuses every new domain. A global admin is not bound by it.
admin.max_users_help: How many mailboxes this admin creates in its managed domains. -1 means unlimited.
admin.max_aliases_help: How many mail aliases this admin creates in its managed domains. -1 means unlimited.
admin.max_lists_help: How many mailing lists this admin creates in its managed domains. -1 means unlimited.
admin.max_quota_help: The sum of the mailbox quotas in the managed domains, in MB. -1 means unlimited. While it is set, a mailbox with unlimited quota is refused.
admin.allow_domain_creation_help: On: the admin creates a new domain and becomes its admin. Off: it manages only the assigned domains.
admin.disable_viewing_mail_log_help: On: the mail log page stays closed for this admin.
admin.disable_managing_quarantined_mails_help: On: the admin sees the quarantine but neither releases nor deletes a message.

alias.moderators_hint_help: Moderators can approve messages when access policy is set to "Moderators Only".
alias.local_part_help: The part before the @ of the address. The domain box completes it.
alias.display_name_help: A free name for the panel lists. It does not change the address.
alias.access_policy_help: Who may send mail to this address. Public accepts every sender, Domain only a sender of the same domain, Members Only a member, Moderators Only a moderator.
alias.members_hint_help: Every member gets a copy of the mail sent to the address. Write one address per line; an address outside the served domains is also accepted.
alias.members_oneline_help: The mail of the address goes to these members, one address per line. What you save here replaces the stored list.
alias.rename_address_help: The new local part replaces the part before the @. The members and the settings stay, but mail to the old address is no longer delivered.

domainalias.msg_same_as_target: Alias domain cannot be the same as target domain
domainalias.msg_is_mail_domain: The domain :alias is a mail domain and cannot be an alias domain
domainalias.msg_target_not_found: The target domain :domain does not exist
domainalias.alias_domain_name_help: Mail sent to this domain is delivered to the same local part in the target domain. The alias domain holds no mailbox of its own.
domainalias.target_domain_help: The mail domain that receives the mail of the alias domain.

domainownership.title: Domain Ownership Verification
domainownership.txt_hint: Add a TXT record to your domain's DNS with the verification code shown above.
domainownership.msg_txt_missing: No DNS TXT record with the verification code was found for :domain.
domainownership.msg_force_verified: Domain :domain marked as verified without a DNS check.

deletedmbx.title: Deleted Mailboxes
deletedmbx.cancel_confirm: Cancel deletion? The mailbox directory will be preserved.
deletedmbx.msg_not_found: The deletion record no longer exists.
deletedmbx.msg_rescheduled: The mailbox deletion was rescheduled to :date.

log.title: Activity Log
log.not_configured: Activity logging is not configured. Set IREDPANEL_IREDADMIN_DB_* environment variables to enable.
log.delete_all_confirm: Delete ALL log entries? This cannot be undone.
log.event_help: The kind of action that the row records. Empty shows every kind.

lastlogin.title: Last Login Tracking
lastlogin.empty: No login data available. Dovecot last_login plugin may not be enabled.

greylist.tracking_intro: Messages that have passed greylisting verification.
greylist.senders_label: Senders (one per line, e.g., @example.com or user@example.com)
greylist.state_inherit: Use the domain or global setting
greylist.msg_inherited: Own greylisting setting removed. The domain or global setting applies.
greylist.no_accounts: No account has an own greylisting setting.
greylist.remove_settings_confirm: Remove the greylisting setting and the whitelisted senders of this account?
greylist.domains_intro: The iRedAPD job resolves the SPF records of these domains into whitelisted senders.
greylist.no_spf_senders: The job has not resolved a sender yet.
greylist.state_for_help: Greylisting refuses the first delivery attempt of an unknown sender and accepts the retry. It stops much spam and delays the first mail of a new sender by a few minutes.
greylist.senders_label_help: Senders that skip greylisting, one per line: user@example.com, @example.com for a whole domain, or an IP address.
greylist.domains_label_help: One domain per line. The iRedAPD job reads the SPF record of each domain and whitelists the sending servers it finds. Removing a domain also drops the senders that came from it.

resource.title: Account Resources
resource.intro: Replicate mail users and groups from Active Directory or a Samba AD domain controller into a hosted domain. The directory stays the source: accounts are created, updated, renamed and disabled here when they change there. Passwords are not replicated; set them in the panel.
resource.target_domain_help: Only accounts with an address in this domain are replicated.
resource.tls_help: Port 636 always uses LDAP over SSL. Another port uses StartTLS when this is on.
resource.tls_verify_help: Turn this off only for a server with a self-signed certificate on a trusted network.
resource.password_keep: Leave empty to keep the stored password
resource.interval_help: The cron job runs every minute and replicates this resource when the interval has passed.
resource.replicate_groups: Replicate groups as mail alias accounts
resource.replicate_groups_help: Group members are replicated too. Manage the members in the directory.
resource.removal_note: An account that is removed from the directory is disabled here, never deleted. If a search returns no accounts, or more than half of ten or more accounts disappear at once, nothing is disabled and the run is marked partial.
resource.mail_attribute: Get the full email address from attribute
resource.mail_attribute_help: The value must be a unique address that ends with @:domain. Other accounts are skipped.
resource.profile_mapping_help: Select a directory attribute for each field, or type another name. Leave a field empty to not replicate it. Replicated fields can be changed only in the directory.
resource.default_access_policy_help: Applies to a new alias. The policy of an existing alias is not changed.
resource.connection_ok: Connection succeeded. The first users and groups are shown below.
resource.skip_duplicate_address: Address used by another entry: skipped
resource.held_back: Accounts that disappeared from the directory but were not disabled: :count. This looks like a broken search. Check the directory, then run with --allow-mass-disable if the removal is real.
resource.detail_unresolved_members: members that are not replicated accounts: :count
resource.detail_recreated: the local account was missing and is created again
resource.empty: No account resources. Add Active Directory or Samba AD to start.
resource.delete_confirm: Delete this account resource? The replicated accounts stay as local accounts.
resource.msg_no_iredadmin: Account replication needs the iredadmin database. Configure the IREDPANEL_IREDADMIN_DB_* settings.
resource.msg_password_unreadable: The stored bind password cannot be read, because IREDPANEL_SECRET_KEY changed. Enter the password again.
resource.msg_incomplete: Save the connection settings and the bind password before you enable the resource.
resource.msg_running: A replication of this resource is running. Try again later.
resource.managed_help: This account is replicated from the directory. The replicated fields can be changed only there.
resource.msg_managed: The directory manages :address. Change it in the directory.
resource.managed_group_help: This group is replicated from the directory. Its name and members can be changed only there.
resource.host_help: The name or the IP address of the domain controller. The panel reads the directory over it.
resource.port_help: 389 for LDAP with StartTLS, 636 for LDAP over SSL. The port must match the TLS setting.
resource.timeout_help: How long the panel waits for the directory to answer. The run stops with an error after this.
resource.base_dn_help: The directory subtree that the search starts from. An entry outside it is not found.
resource.bind_dn_help: The DN of the account that the panel binds with. A read-only account is enough.
resource.bind_password_help: The password of the bind account. It is stored encrypted and is never written back into this page.
resource.user_filter_help: The LDAP filter of the entries that become mailboxes. An entry outside the filter is left alone.
resource.group_filter_help: The LDAP filter of the entries that become mail aliases. It is read only while group replication is on.
resource.account_status_help: The attribute that carries the enabled state. userAccountControl is read as a bit field; another attribute counts as disabled when its value reads as off. Empty leaves the local status alone.
resource.group_mail_attribute_help: The attribute that carries the address of the group. The value must be a unique address in the target domain.
resource.group_name_attribute_help: The attribute that carries the display name of the group. Empty leaves the name of the alias empty.

self.msg_released: The message was released to your mailbox.
self.release_confirm: Deliver this message to your mailbox?
self.spam_policy_default: You use the spam policy of your domain or of the server. Save the form to set your own policy.
self.spam_policy_reset_confirm: Delete your own spam policy and use the default policy?
self.no_pages: Your domain admin closed all self-service pages.

export.ldif_tree: Export the LDAP tree as LDIF
export.ldif_password_warning: The file holds the password hashes. Keep it as safe as a backup.

maillist.intro: A mail list delivers the message to its members. The admin manages the members; a member cannot subscribe or unsubscribe itself.
maillist.allowed_hint: Addresses that may always send to this list (one per line)
maillist.max_message_size_help: Maximum message size in bytes. 0 means no limit.
maillist.allowed_hint_help: These addresses may always send to the list, even when the access policy refuses them. One address per line.
